channel.title: Happy Hearts at Home
channel.description: Birth, loss, and the days after. One mother's account of losing a baby at nine weeks, and of two home births.

item.title: Why I chose a midwife
item.description: What I was actually offered at nine weeks pregnant, what I got, and what I would tell a friend who asked me the same question.

item.title: At 9:43 in the evening
item.description: Hezekiah arrived weighing nine pounds twelve ounces, and then the room changed very quickly.

item.title: Karis, at dawn
item.description: Seventeen hours of labour, thirteen of them with no pain, and a watermelon eaten in the birthing pool.

item.title: Why are you so worried?
item.description: A letter to God in the autumn of 2017, a pregnancy two days later, and a dream that asked me the question nobody had.

item.title: Nine weeks and three days
item.description: The summer there was no heartbeat, the three choices nobody should have to make, and the call ten days afterwards.
